description: This file contains C code implementing a set of validation and checking functions, such as memory clearing, string error handling, constant time memory comparisons, memory allocation wrappers, and backtrace utilities. It is part of a library used for safety and debugging within a larger software project.

methods.name: errno_t ck_memclear_s(void * const s,const rsize_t smax,rsize_t n)
methods.description: Clears a memory block securely using various mechanisms depending on system capabilities. Implements runtime checks and fallback methods for memory zeroing.

methods.name: errno_t ck_strerror_s(char * const s,const rsize_t maxsize,const errno_t errnum)
methods.description: Provides thread-safe string representations of error numbers, with fallback to snprintf if native support is unavailable.

methods.name: int ck_memeq_const_time(const void * a,size_t alen,const void * b,size_t blen)
methods.description: Performs a constant-time equality comparison between two memory regions to prevent timing attacks.

methods.name: int ck_memeq_const_time_fixed_len(const void * a,const void * b,const size_t len)
methods.description: Performs a fixed-length, constant-time comparison between two memory regions, suitable for digest comparisons.

methods.name: void * ck_calloc(size_t nmemb,size_t elt_sz)
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory and asserts non-nullity.

methods.name: void * ck_realloc_u32(void ** list,size_t n,size_t x,size_t elt_sz)
methods.description: Reallocates an array with overflow checks, used for dynamic list management.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ void ck_backtrace(FILE * fp)
methods.description: Generates a backtrace of the current call stack using libunwind, for debugging purposes.

methods.name: void ck_bt(const char * filename,unsigned int line,const char * msg)
methods.description: Logs a backtrace with a message prefix.

methods.name: __attribute_noreturn__ void ck_bt_abort(const char * filename,unsigned int line,const char * msg)
methods.description: Logs a backtrace and aborts execution, used in critical failure cases.

methods.name: __attribute_noreturn__ void ck_assert_failed(const char * filename,unsigned int line,const char * msg)
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure message with a backtrace and terminates execution.
